{"scenarios": [{"obligation_avoided": "Protection against use of the company's information to build competing products.", "segments": [61], "quotes": ["nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as a representation that Recipient has not or will not independently develop products that compete"], "how": "The recipient argues that it may build a competing product from the information and rely on this clause, provided it can say it did so without breaching the Agreement. Nothing requires it to show the product was developed without use of the information.", "loophole_type": "independent_development"}, {"obligation_avoided": "Protection of information that the recipient's staff or contractors could claim to have developed on their own.", "segments": [34], "quotes": ["is independently developed by an employee, agent or consultant of Recipient without reference to the Confidential Information"], "how": "The recipient has its employees or consultants develop similar work and then claims the exclusion, shifting the burden to the company to prove that the work referred to the Confidential Information.", "loophole_type": "independent_development"}, {"obligation_avoided": "Confidentiality obligations lasting beyond the agreement's term.", "segments": [24, 25, 82], "quotes": ["The term of this Agreement shall be for the Period of Exchange set forth above.", "Either party may terminate this Agreement upon 30 days prior written notice.", "19. SURVIVAL."], "how": "The term is tied to a Period of Exchange that is left blank, and either party may end the Agreement on 30 days' notice. The Survival section is empty, so the recipient can argue that its duties end with the term or on termination.", "loophole_type": "short_term"}, {"obligation_avoided": "The company's expectation that its information is returned or destroyed once the exchange ends.", "segments": [41, 42], "quotes": ["except for such copies as may reasonably be required for the purpose as set forth in Section I of this Agreement.", "All such retained copies shall remain subject to the use and disclosure restrictions in this Agreement."], "how": "The recipient makes copies it claims are reasonably required for the purpose and keeps them indefinitely. The Agreement restricts use of those copies but never requires their return or destruction.", "loophole_type": "retained_copies"}, {"obligation_avoided": "Effective injunctive relief against misuse of the company's information.", "segments": [78], "quotes": ["shall, thereby, entitle it to seek injunctive relief in any court with competent jurisdiction over the party or party\u2019s Affiliate in violation."], "how": "The clause only entitles the company to seek an injunction and does not state that the breach is presumed irreparable or that bond is waived. The recipient can contest the request in each case and treat the remedy as optional.", "loophole_type": "weak_remedy"}, {"obligation_avoided": "Notice to the company and a chance to seek a protective order before compelled disclosure.", "segments": [45], "quotes": ["If Recipient is (in the opinion of its counsel) compelled to disclose any Confidential Information"], "how": "The recipient's own counsel decides that disclosure is compelled, and the clause then permits disclosure without liability. Unlike the preceding paragraph, it contains no notice requirement, so the recipient can disclose to a third party without warning the company.", "loophole_type": "other"}, {"obligation_avoided": "Limits on who may receive the company's information.", "segments": [71, 76], "quotes": ["The parties agree that each party and its Affiliates may receive Confidential Information from and/or disclose Confidential Information to the other party and the other party's Affiliates", "the ability to otherwise direct or share management policies of such entity"], "how": "Affiliates are defined broadly, including any entity able to share management policies, and each Affiliate may receive and disclose the information. The recipient can route the information to a loosely related group entity that is not directly bound by the Agreement.", "loophole_type": "other"}, {"obligation_avoided": "Restriction on disclosing the company's information to foreign persons or countries.", "segments": [47], "quotes": ["Neither party shall export, directly or indirectly, any of the Confidential Information to any country, person or entity which the US Government, at the time of export, requires an export license"], "how": "The restriction bites only where the US Government requires a licence at the time of export. The recipient can send the information to any country or person not requiring a licence without breaching this clause.", "loophole_type": "other"}]}

{"scenarios": [{"obligation_avoided": "Confidentiality protection lasting at least the agreed period.", "segments": [17, 19], "quotes": ["The obligations of the Disclosee under this Agreement shall expire the earlier of", "the date the Sale between the Candidate and the Sellers is completed."], "how": "The obligations end on the earlier of the stated period or completion of the Sale. If the Sale completes early, the Candidate can argue that its duty to keep the information confidential has ended, even though the information still has value to the Sellers.", "loophole_type": "short_term"}, {"obligation_avoided": "Direct, enforceable confidentiality duties on everyone who receives the information.", "segments": [3], "quotes": ["such other person is made aware of the provisions of this Agreement and the fact that the Disclosee will be liable"], "how": "The Candidate only needs to make Representatives, advisers and shareholders aware of the Agreement, and none of them signs it. The Sellers would have to disprove that knowledge.", "loophole_type": "other"}]}
